name: BISCIONE V6

specs.notes: Alfa Corse's Class 1 DTM car that beat the German makes on their own ground in 1993: a 2.5 litre V6, 420 hp at 11,800 rpm (about 430 in 1994); full-time four-wheel drive through a centre transfer case, 33 % front / 67 % rear; a six-speed with an H-gate (a sequential from 1994); 1,040 kg with much of the body in carbon (supercars.net, clubalfa.it, historicmotorsportcentral.com). The wheelbase is the road 155's (2,540 mm); torque isn't published (a high-revving NA curve from the power); the 12,000 rpm limiter, ~270 km/h, weight distribution, ratios and aero are estimates.

garage.blurb: A 1993 DTM saloon with a V6 that screams to 12,000 rpm and four-wheel drive: tiny, light, and it grips like it's on rails until it doesn't.

interior.notes: The model's race cockpit: its wheel and its gear lever cut out by part (the boot stays), the seat found by the probe; left-hand drive; the hand works the lever through an H6 gate.

source.license: Sketchfab download; its name ('ac_') suggests an Assetto Corsa extraction. Handled as no-AI: converted and checked by local scripts only, its renders never viewed
